title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 19: the burden of Egypt, the Nile dried up, foolish princes, an altar to Yahweh in Egypt, and a highway to Assyria.

questions.text: On what does Yahweh ride when he comes to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "Behold, Yahweh rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt," and the idols of Egypt tremble at his presence.

questions.text: Against whom will the Egyptians be stirred up to fight?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says the Egyptians will fight everyone against his brother and his neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

questions.text: Into whose hand will Yahweh give over the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them."

answers.text: A cruel lord, a fierce king

questions.text: According to verse 8, who will lament and mourn?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says the fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn.

questions.text: The princes of which city are called utterly foolish?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says, "The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish," and the counsel of Pharaoh's wisest counselors has become stupid.

questions.text: How does Egypt go astray in all of its works?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says they have caused Egypt to go astray in all its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

answers.text: Like a blind man groping at noon
Like a ship without a rudder
Like sheep scattered on the hills
Like a drunken man staggering in his vomit

questions.text: How many cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says that in that day there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan and swear to Yahweh of Armies.

questions.text: What will stand in the middle of the land of Egypt in that day?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says there will be an altar to Yahweh in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.

questions.text: Between which lands will there be a highway in that day?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

questions.text: In the blessing of verse 25, what is Egypt called?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 says, "Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance."
